purpose: casting samples for Robin's choices (C-93): not a final cast, not game audio, not whole-game generation

qwen_design.note: The voice is designed from the description; the mood is added to the same instruction; the seed is fixed per voice.

aivis.note: Concrete models, speakers and styles for the narrator candidates N1–N7 and the AV-* slots are chosen on the PC and recorded in va2_voices.json.

nemo.engine: VOICEVOX Nemo engine (VOICEVOX API; port to verify, 50121 assumed)
nemo.note: Middle-aged men only (Robin). NM-A is the voice Robin preferred in VA-1 for the middle-aged man; NM-B and NM-C are other Nemo male voices.

sound.note: A sourced recording, not speech: an animal that only makes its sound. The file and its licence are recorded in va2_voices.json → sounds.

fx.echo_light: A slight echo and a small room: two soft repeats (90 and 180 ms) under the voice. For the Mill Echo.
fx.hush: Foreboding: the voice two semitones lower with its formants kept, a faint octave-below shadow, the top rolled off, and a long dark reverb. For the Hush.
fx.spirit: Gentle and airy: a light shimmer (two slightly detuned copies) and a bright, short reverb.
fx.ancient: Huge and old: one semitone lower with the formants a little lower too, and a large hall.
fx.hollow: A voice from an object or a place: narrowed to 300–3,400 Hz with a short slapback.
fx.ghost: A soft reverb and a slight, slow waver in pitch.
fx.ember: Warm with a little grit (gentle saturation) and a small room.

cat_meow.for: Mochi (rw.mochi_find, rw.mochi_home: ニャー), and any cat that meows later
cat_meow.want: one basic, clean domestic cat meow, about 0.5–1.5 s, no background noise, no other animal or voice
cat_meow.licence: CC0 or public domain only, as stated on the recording's own page (for example a Wikimedia Commons file page); record the URL, author, licence and SHA-256; a recording whose terms cannot be confirmed is not used

clean.rule: Clear articulation; every word ends cleanly; no breathiness, no trailing sounds.
clean.check: After each take: the time before the first voiced sound and the unvoiced tail after the last are measured; a take with more than 0.20 s of sound before the voice or 0.18 s of tail is made again with the next seed (at most three tries, the cleanest kept). Silence is trimmed to 60 ms each side; the tail keeps up to 100 ms of unvoiced sound so a devoiced です still ends naturally.

loudness: Every take is set to −20 LUFS (integrated), peaks under −1 dBFS, 48 kHz mono, after any fx.

cr.lw_sl_cr_rin_r2#f1bbb81823.textNamesKana: 宿場の長さを、自分の足で測っています。聞いた数字は、もう使いません。

cr.lw_bear#92473cce05.textNamesKana: 話しながら歩くと、怖くないものですね。

cr.lw_kajika#dc7d973cdc.textNamesKana: ……夏になったら、ここに聞きに来る。

cs.seto_idle#8d4645adc1.textNamesKana: 丘の上は、風がよく通るの。洗濯物がすぐ乾くわ。

fw.f5_fumi#1f794de2d0.jp: この {頃|ごろ} は 、 {鐘|かね} は {向|む}こう の {花|はな} だけ を {鳴|な}らす 。 {静|しず}か で 、 いい わ 。
fw.f5_fumi#1f794de2d0.en: These days the chime rings only the flower over there. It's quiet. I like it.
fw.f5_fumi#1f794de2d0.text: この頃は、鐘は向こうの花だけを鳴らす。静かで、いいわ。
fw.f5_fumi#1f794de2d0.textNamesKana: この頃は、鐘は向こうの花だけを鳴らす。静かで、いいわ。

sets.label: Set 1: both voices androgynous
sets.A: A young adult in their early twenties with a light, bright, clear voice; androgynous; mid-high pitch; friendly, attentive and natural, standard Tokyo Japanese.
sets.B: An adult in their late twenties with a low, warm, steady voice; androgynous, leaning deeper; calm and kind, standard Tokyo Japanese.

sets.label: Set 2: A leaning feminine, B leaning masculine
sets.A: A woman in her early twenties with a bright, lively, clear voice; mid-high pitch; quick and sincere, standard Tokyo Japanese.
sets.B: A man in his late twenties with a low, warm, gentle voice; relaxed and dependable, standard Tokyo Japanese.

sets.label: Set 3: a youthful tenor-alto and a mellow alto-baritone
sets.A: A youthful voice around twenty, a clear tenor-alto, slightly boyish and earnest; light and quick, standard Tokyo Japanese.
sets.B: A thoughtful adult in their thirties, a mellow alto-baritone; unhurried and soft-spoken, standard Tokyo Japanese.

moods.neutral: Speak in a natural, neutral conversational tone.
moods.happy: Speak happily, with a warm smile in the voice.
moods.sad: Speak sadly and quietly, holding the feeling back.
moods.frustrated: Speak with restrained frustration: firm, a little exasperated, never shouting.
moods.excited: Speak with excitement, as if suddenly realising something important.

texts.jp: {町|まち} の {中|なか} で 、 {話|はなし} を {聞|き}こう 。
{祭|まつ}り の {前|まえ} に {着|つ}いた みたい だ ね 。
texts.en: Looks like we've arrived just before the festival.
texts.text: 祭りの前に着いたみたいだね。
texts.textNamesKana: 祭りの前に着いたみたいだね。

texts.jp: {何年|なんねん} か {前|まえ} に {亡|な}くなった そう です 。 {渡|わた}し{舟|ぶね} は 、 {息子|むすこ} の コウジ さん が {継|つ}いで います 。
texts.en: She passed away some years ago. Her son Kōji runs the ferry now.
texts.text: 何年か前に亡くなったそうです。渡し舟は、息子のコウジさんが継いでいます。
texts.textNamesKana: 何年か前に亡くなったそうです。渡し舟は、息子のコウジさんが継いでいます。

texts.jp: でも 、{下町|したまち} が {沈|しず}んだ {日|ひ} です よ 。
texts.en: But that's the day the lower quarter drowned.
texts.text: でも、下町が沈んだ日ですよ。
texts.textNamesKana: でも、下町が沈んだ日ですよ。

texts.jp: キヨ さん の 「{日|ひ} の {昇|のぼ}る ほう 」 は {東|ひがし} 。 {三人|さんにん} とも 、 {同|おな}じ {場所|ばしょ} を {指|さ}して いた ん だ 。
texts.en: And Kiyo's "where the sun comes up" is east. All three were pointing at the same place.
texts.text: キヨさんの「日の昇るほう」は東。三人とも、同じ場所を指していたんだ。
texts.textNamesKana: キヨさんの「日の昇るほう」は東。三人とも、同じ場所を指していたんだ。

text.jp: {運河|うんが} の {上|うえ} に 、 {橋|はし} が {次|つぎ} から {次|つぎ} へ と {架|か}かって いる 。 {八百|はっぴゃく} の {橋|はし} の {町|まち} 、 {八百橋|やおばし} だ 。
text.en: Bridge after bridge spans the canal. Manybridge: the city of eight hundred bridges.

neutral.label: Directed-Neutral
neutral.note: The model's own neutral style; steady storyteller pace, the emphasis and pronunciation of the model, no added colour.

energetic.label: Directed-Energetic
energetic.note: The model's brightest style if it has one (テンション高め, 上機嫌, 喜び…); otherwise its neutral style with stronger inflection and a little more pace.

narrator.choose: Seven distinct adult female AivisSpeech models (AIVMX, free on AivisHub or already installed), one candidate per model: a calm, clear storyteller is the target. Prefer different timbres (warm low, clear mid, light high, mature, soft, crisp, rich). Use the default Anneli model as one of them if installed. Each model's licence must allow use in a free, distributed game with credit; record it.

npc.rules: Applied from Robin's instructions of 2026-10-14 and the VA-1 addendum (§07–§08): most NPCs use Qwen3-TTS 1.7B VoiceDesign, described in natural language for age, presentation, timbre, pace and register, and every description ends by asking for clean word endings with no breathiness or trailing sounds; AivisSpeech is used for bubbly or high-energy feminine voices (energetic girls, bright young women, lively performers and shop women); VOICEVOX Nemo is used only for ordinary, grounded middle-aged men, while middle-aged men with a strong particular character (showmen, a vain author, a ceremonious official) stay on Qwen. Each sample is read neutrally, except children who are always excited or happy, who keep that tone. Every supernatural speaker carries an effect preset (the Hush's functionary foreboding, the Mill Echo a light echo, lamps and objects hollow, ghosts and the Hundredth Tale's tellers ghostly, shape-shifting animals and kindly spirits a shimmer, huge old beings a big hall, fire beings warmth). Voices are cast by character fit, never by a pitch rule attached to pronouns; they/them characters and speakers whose gender the text never gives are voiced by fit (often androgynous), not forced into a gender; ages are not reduced to lowered pitch or frailty, and children use ordinary age-appropriate speech without caricature.

supernatural.why: The Hush itself has no spoken line; the Tide Clerk is its only speaking functionary ("The Hush erases them. I only tidy up"), so it carries the foreboding Hush preset.

genderNotStated.note: No pronoun is given for these in the text or the content comments. "inferred": cast by Japanese speech, the name's form and the look (see each evidence). "unknown": nothing points either way, so cast androgynous by fit.

ageNotEstablished.note: No age in the text, the comments or the look (age/size); the age here is a casting guess from role and manner. Ages from look.age old / size child, from a stated age, or from family role (a grown child, a grandchild, thirty years in a post) are not listed.

summary.theHush: The Hush (静寂) never speaks: no say-line in any scene has it as speaker (the climax sa.hush_core has narration and Kasane only; sa2 only hushes the companion). Its foreboding preset goes to its one speaking functionary, the Tide Clerk (sg_clerk). Kasane, the human antagonist, is cast without an effect.
